description: The file defines an interface for filesystem-related utility functions such as checking for folder existence, file existence, determining if a file is regular, and creating an empty file. It primarily declares function prototypes with brief documentation.

methods.name: bbfdm_folder_exists
methods.description: Checks whether a folder exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bbfdm_file_exists
methods.description: Checks whether a file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bbfdm_is_regular_file
methods.description: Determines if the file at the given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bbfdm_create_empty_file
methods.description: Creates an empty file at the given path, if it does not already exist.
